summary: One blocking finding is valid and should be repaired by defining target-external dirty precedence for both metadata commit and downstream reset.

items.title: R3 and R4 do not define the external-dirty retry-reset intersection
items.rationale: The spec must state whether downstream skipped reset may mutate and commit flow.json when a target-external dirty path exists. User-work protection requires target-external dirty paths to block all finalize-merge pre-hook metadata commits, including the reset commit.
items.evidence: spec.json R3 protects target-external dirty paths, while R4 preserves downstream skipped reset. src/flow/registry.js currently commits reset flow.json in finalize-merge pre hook, so the precedence must be explicit before implementation.
